title: ScreamingTrees
description: Are you tired of players cutting down trees?
body:
Original plugin
EffectLib IS REQUIRED FOR THIS PLUGIN TO FUNCTION PROPERLY

Support me via ko-fi



Are you tired of players cutting down trees? Do you feel as if players just cut too many of them down? Then get ScreamingTrees! All a player has to do is chop, punch, or slash their way through a log to make the tree scream. The guilt instantly overwhelms any player. If the tree feels like it, it might even let the player know how it feels! And due to popular demand, trees now throw apples at players!

Current Features:


  • Breaking logs makes the tree scream and bleed!
  • Trees might also say something to the player
  • Trees can now throw apples at players!
  • Configuration for screaming chance, bleeding, speaking chance, throwing chance and damage, and allowed worlds and biomes
